title: Reservation Capacity Governing Source Policy
purpose: Assign explicit v1 reservation-governance policy meaning to equality between each revision selected by a canonical FOOD-007N hold command and the complete supplied highest-recorded revision observations for those exact streams.

policyRule.rule: A selected capacity-source revision satisfies v1 only when it equals the supplied highest-recorded revision observation for its exact stream.
policyRule.overallMatch: Every selected SKU stream and the selected fulfillment-slot stream must satisfy exact revision equality.

inputs.commandInput: The original FOOD-007N construction input, replayed through deriveFoodReservationHoldCommand.

observations.skuObservations: Exactly one observation for every selected exact SKU id/version stream. Input order is arbitrary; output is normalized to canonical command-demand order.
observations.slotObservation: Exactly one observation for the selected method/locationReference/windowReference stream.

result.matches-policy: The complete supplied observation set is valid and every selected revision equals the supplied highest-recorded revision for its exact stream.
result.does-not-match-policy: The complete supplied observation set is valid and at least one exact-stream selected revision differs from its supplied highest-recorded revision.
result.invalid: The command input, observation structure, complete-set requirement, exact-stream binding, or revision structure is invalid.

exactStreamBinding: SKU stream identity is sku.id plus sku.version. Fulfillment-slot stream identity is method plus locationReference plus windowReference. Revision numbers are never compared across unrelated streams.
completeSetRule: Every selected SKU must have exactly one supplied observation and the exact selected slot must have exactly one supplied observation. Missing, duplicate, unknown-extra, or wrongly bound observations are invalid.
observationBoundary: The policy evaluates only the complete observations supplied to this invocation. It does not acquire observations, authenticate their provenance, prove their age, or claim they form one simultaneous snapshot.
food007iRelationship: FOOD-007I is database-backed latest-recorded observation/comparison evidence. FOOD-007O performs no database reads and adds the explicit v1 policy meaning that exact-stream selected-equals-observed-highest satisfies reservation source governance relative to the supplied observations.
mutationTimeRecheck: A cached FOOD-007O result is not sufficient for reservation mutation. A future authoritative writer must reacquire authoritative state and enforce the governing-source policy inside its mutation boundary.
trustBoundary: Structural validity does not authenticate caller identity, database origin, sourceReference, attribution, observation freshness, or service authority.
physicalTruthBoundary: Highest-recorded and governing-under-v1 do not establish physical currentness, physical truth, fresh physical count, current physical QOH, sellable stock, or available capacity.
commitmentScopeBoundary: FOOD-007O does not define which recorded-held commitments count against a governing capacity assertion and does not define cross-revision commitment carry-forward.
admissionBoundary: FOOD-007O performs no quantity arithmetic and does not establish capacity sufficiency, insufficiency, remaining capacity, reservable quantity, ATP, or permission to reserve.
acceptanceBoundary: FOOD-007O creates no reservation acceptance or rejection and does not authenticate successful durable reservation mutation.
atomicityBoundary: FOOD-007O performs no mutation and provides no all-or-nothing reservation guarantee, rollback guarantee, oversell prevention, or slot-overbooking prevention.

safeClaim.matches-policy: Relative to the complete supplied exact-stream observations, every selected revision satisfies v1's selected-equals-observed-highest rule.
safeClaim.does-not-match-policy: The complete supplied observations contain at least one exact-stream revision inequality under v1.

sideEffects: Pure synchronous policy evaluation only. No database access, SQL, network, filesystem access, clock, randomness, environment access, reservation mutation, or acceptance creation.
